purpose: Keyboard and accessibility behavior candidates; apply by semantic role, not visual shape.

patterns.inside: none
patterns.note: Native button first; repeated activation must not duplicate submission.

patterns.inside: none
patterns.note: Use a link for navigation; avoid button semantics on a destination.

patterns.inside: none
patterns.note: Label should name what is selected.

patterns.operate: Space (Enter only if implementation supports it)
patterns.inside: none
patterns.note: Stable label names setting, not just current state.

patterns.inside: Arrow keys move among options
patterns.note: Prefer native grouped radios.

patterns.inside: Left/Right in horizontal list; Up/Down in vertical list; Home/End optional
patterns.exit: Tab to panel or next focusable item
patterns.focus: roving tabindex: one tab at 0, others at -1
patterns.note: Arrow keys stay scoped to focused tablist; do not intercept page scrolling otherwise.

patterns.inside: none; optional heading shortcuts only with reason
patterns.note: Collapsed content must not retain tabbable descendants.

patterns.inside: Arrow keys among menu items; Home/End optional
patterns.exit: Escape closes and returns trigger; Tab follows chosen menu policy
patterns.note: Use menu semantics for commands, not an ordinary list of links unless behavior matches.

patterns.operate: Space / Enter selection according to single/multiple policy
patterns.inside: Up/Down; Home/End optional; type-ahead when supported
patterns.note: Do not confuse menu commands with value selection.

patterns.inside: Down/Up navigates popup when open
patterns.exit: Escape closes popup; Tab continues page flow
patterns.focus: input remains focused or active descendant tracked
patterns.note: Typing and IME composition must not trigger global shortcuts.

patterns.entry: trigger receives Tab; opening moves focus inside
patterns.inside: Tab / Shift+Tab cycle only inside modal
patterns.exit: Escape closes; focus returns to opener or logical successor
patterns.note: Background becomes inert while modal is open.

patterns.entry: Tab to thumbnail; Enter / Space opens
patterns.operate: Left/Right moves previous/next image while open; buttons offer same actions
patterns.inside: Tab / Shift+Tab among close and navigation controls
patterns.exit: Escape closes and restores thumbnail focus
patterns.focus: image viewer contains focus while open
patterns.note: Arrow keys only while viewer owns focus; do not steal keys from text fields or another overlay.

patterns.entry: Tab through rotation, previous/next, and picker controls
patterns.inside: Arrow keys only if picker is a tablist or explicitly documented
patterns.state: current slide name and position available
patterns.note: Auto rotation stops on keyboard focus and does not resume without explicit user action.

patterns.inside: Left/Right horizontal or Up/Down vertical; Home/End optional
patterns.note: Preserve text-input arrow behavior inside mixed toolbars.

patterns.operate: Arrow keys change step; PageUp/Down and Home/End where supported
patterns.inside: one or two thumbs according to range contract
patterns.note: Do not use arrows as page-level shortcuts while slider focused.

patterns.operate: Enter / Space activates according to selection policy
patterns.inside: Up/Down items; Right expands or enters; Left collapses or goes parent; Home/End
patterns.note: Meaningful hierarchy and keyboard alternative required.

patterns.operate: Enter / F2 enters cell editing if supported
patterns.inside: Arrow keys move among cells; Home/End per grid policy
patterns.exit: Tab leaves grid or enters cell widgets by documented policy
patterns.note: Escape leaves editing before leaving the grid.

patterns.inside: text-editing keys keep native behavior
patterns.exit: Tab / Shift+Tab; Escape only if clear/close is documented
patterns.note: Global shortcuts must not fire while typing or composing text.

patterns.operate: keyboard pick-up / move / drop or explicit up/down buttons
patterns.inside: announced position changes
patterns.exit: Escape cancels and restores original order
patterns.state: new position and cancel result announced
patterns.note: Pointer drag alone cannot be the only way to reorder.

patterns.operate: Enter / Space on buttons; media-specific seek keys only while focused
patterns.inside: slider owns arrows during seek
patterns.note: Do not override system/browser media shortcuts globally.
